sounds.soundName: What song is this? Flower JPOP

scripts: Well then, let me tell you how to dress me up.
Click and drag an item on me.
The hair is in the way, so
If you'd like all of the hair to get out of your way, then press the up arrow.
If you want all the hair to appear, press 7
If you want to change the color of an item,
To change the item back to the way it was,
Press A for Accessories, C for all clothing and H for Hair.
To change my skin color, press a number.
To change the background, press B.
If you'd like to add anything, you can just remix.
